name: session-ux
description: Opt-in conveniences for the human-facing seats: a status line with model, context gauge, pending drops and ship role; compaction hooks that restore the Mate/Navigator role mid-task after a compaction, add a checkpoint catch-up only when the ship repo holds unsaved work, and log each compaction; a role-aware macOS notification hook. Installing makes the hooks executable; registering them in ~/.claude/settings.json is a manual step (see session-ux.md).
